translations.answer: In the 23-DoF G1 setting of the HoST report, the multi-critic PPO with staged rewards, gradually removed vertical tension, action amplitude curriculum, and smooth regularization collectively achieved standing-up in four scenarios; the real-robot main trial was 20/20, but pure body sense may still cause collisions with the environment, and the result cannot be considered as a safe guarantee for unknown postures or other robots.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: Collision geometry and robot-specific joint/actuator limits are validated before training.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: The initial posture belongs to a separately tested terrain/posture operating envelope.
translations.confidence_rationale: Large controlled simulation ablations, a 20-trial main real-robot comparison, robustness probes and public implementation support the mechanism. Confidence is capped by small hardware denominators, proprioception-only collision risk and unresolved multi-posture interference.
translations.evidence.0.note: Defines multi-critic standing-up control, randomization, ablations, real trials and sim-to-real limits.
translations.evidence.0.title: Learning Humanoid Standing-up Control across Diverse Postures
translations.evidence.1.locator: HostGround.step, update_force_curriculum, ActorCritic.critics and RolloutStorage.multi_critic_advantages at 70bb580
translations.evidence.1.note: Maps pulling/action curricula and multiple-critic optimization to official code.
translations.evidence.1.title: OpenRobotLab/HoST official implementation
translations.safety.command_limits: Derive robot- and firmware-specific position, velocity, torque, current, temperature, contact-force and action-rescale limits; paper values are not deployment limits.
translations.safety.emergency_stop: Test an independent human-accessible emergency stop and safe power-removal behavior before any unsupported motion.
translations.safety.protective_controls: Use compatible fall arrest or padded capture, a cleared exclusion zone, pinch/contact protection, current/thermal monitoring and a dedicated safety operator.
translations.safety.robot_specific_warning: The main hardware evidence is a 23-DoF Unitree G1; H1/H1-2 and other morphologies expose different torque and upper-body contact gaps and require new validation.
translations.safety.staged_deployment: Proceed from fixed-seed simulation and collision audit to supported low-speed single-posture tests, then bounded surfaces/postures, and only after acceptance to unsupported recovery.
translations.title: How can a humanoid robot stand up when no trajectory is given?
